card.line: Arad was a Canaanite city in the Negev, south of Hebron. Its king attacked Israel in the wilderness, and later its king was listed among those Israel defeated.

moments.title: The king of Arad attacks Israel
moments.text: The Canaanite king of Arad heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim. He attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.

moments.title: Israel's vow and Hormah
moments.text: Israel vowed to the LORD that they would devote the Canaanite cities to destruction if He delivered the people into their hands. The LORD heard their plea and gave them the victory, so the place was named Hormah.

moments.title: The king of Arad in the list of defeated kings
moments.text: In the list of kings Israel defeated, the king of Arad is named right after the king of Hormah.

moments.title: The Kenites settle near Arad
moments.text: The descendants of Moses' father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They went to live among the people.
